Here is a description of the provided video segment:

The video begins with a title slide for "Back to Nature," an Applied Improvisation Network World Gathering in Montreal, Canada, from September 24-27, 2015. The title is in green cursive. The slide transitions to a shot of a man on a stage, who identifies himself as a nerd. He is wearing a gray hoodie over a pink and white checkered shirt. He's holding a microphone and gesturing with his hands as he addresses an audience of approximately 25 people, who are sitting and listening. A screen behind him displays the title "Improvising Conversation: From Socially Awkward to Socially Awesome," along with the logo for "Humor That Works" and his name, Andrew Tarvin. The setting is rustic, featuring a wooden barn-like interior. In the background, a whiteboard is seen, covered with handwritten notes and doodles. The camera focuses on the speaker as he explains that in addition to being a nerd, he also does stand-up and improv comedy and has performed around a thousand shows in 49 states, 14 countries, and on 3 continents.
